_context.viewer.fallbackAgentName: Stands in for a coworker whose name is unknown, inside sentences like award cards.
_context.weekPicker.new: Badge on the newest week the user has not watched yet.
_context.intro.headline: Title of the first slide of the weekly recap story. "rerun" plays on the product name Rerun: the week replayed.
_context.intro.clockedInOne: Under the title: exactly one coworker worked this week.
_context.intro.clockedInOther: Under the title: {count} coworkers worked this week.
_context.hours.units.hours: Unit shown in big type right after an animated number of hours.
_context.hours.units.minutes: Unit shown in big type right after an animated number of minutes.
_context.hours.workdays: {days} can be a decimal (1.5). The <b> part is bold.
_context.hours.vsLastWeek: {change} is a signed percentage, like +12% or -8%.
_context.rhythm.headline: <value></value> is an animated number of runs. {day} is a weekday name, like Tuesday.
_context.rhythm.finished: Runs that ended well this week.
_context.rhythm.errors: Runs that failed and reported it to the user.
_context.clock.eyebrow: Small caps label above the slide showing activity at every hour of the week.
_context.clock.headline: <value></value> is an animated percentage, like 42%.
_context.clock.hourMark: Short label of an hour on a 24 hour axis, like 6h or 18h.
_context.clock.less: Left end of a heatmap legend going from less to more activity.
_context.clock.more: Right end of a heatmap legend going from less to more activity.
_context.mvp.eyebrow: The coworker who did the most work this week.
_context.mvp.stats.runs: Caption under a number of runs.
_context.mvp.stats.share: Caption under a percentage: the share of all the runs this coworker did.
_context.mvp.stats.onTheClock: Caption under a duration: how long this coworker worked.
_context.mvp.goToMoves: {tools} is a comma separated list of the coworker's most used tools.
_context.mvp.inSpace: {space} is the name of the space (a group of coworkers) the coworker belongs to.
_context.connectors.eyebrow: The apps the coworkers called the most.
_context.connectors.headline: {name} is an app, like Gmail.
_context.connectors.calls: <value></value> is an animated number of calls to the app.
_context.awards.headline: Title of the slide that hands out playful awards to coworkers.
_context.memory.recalled: {name} is the coworker who read this memory the most.
_context.memory.headline: <value></value> is an animated number of memories the coworkers wrote.
_context.outro.eyebrow: Small caps label of the last slide of the story.
_context.outro.mvp: Line at the bottom of the recap card. {name} is the coworker of the week.
_context.outro.watchAgain: Button that replays the story from the start.
_context.outro.backToBoard: Button that closes the story and goes back to the board of coworkers.
_context.tools: Short names of the tools a coworker used, shown in a list of its go-to moves.
